label: Read TEM data
description: Reads dense array data from disk using ncempy and streams it out as batched dense frames.

parameters.name: raw_data_dir
parameters.label: Raw data directory
parameters.description: The directory containing the files to read.

parameters.name: file
parameters.label: File name
parameters.description: The name of the file to read.

parameters.name: batch_size_mb
parameters.label: Batch size (MB)
parameters.description: The size of each emitted batch in megabytes.

parameters.name: scan_shape_y
parameters.label: Scan shape (Y)
parameters.description: Override scan shape Y dimension. 0 = auto-detect from a 4D array.

parameters.name: scan_shape_x
parameters.label: Scan shape (X)
parameters.description: Override scan shape X dimension. 0 = auto-detect from a 4D array.

parameters.name: frame_shape_y
parameters.label: Frame shape (Y)
parameters.description: Override frame shape Y dimension. 0 = auto-detect from a 4D array.

parameters.name: frame_shape_x
parameters.label: Frame shape (X)
parameters.description: Override frame shape X dimension. 0 = auto-detect from a 4D array.

parameters.name: cache_last_file
parameters.label: Cache last file
parameters.description: Cache the last loaded file to avoid re-reading between triggers.

triggers.name: read_now
triggers.label: Read TEM data now
triggers.description: Manually read the file and emit the next batch of dense frames without waiting.
